scope: Follow-up correction: encyclopedia equipment type names and separate named-item quality
notes: Corrects the earlier prefix convention after user feedback; the previous ledger remains historical.
Individual encyclopedia type labels use base category + （红装）. These labels are not claims about an instantiated item name.
Game armor and helmet name pools remain unchanged. No random name is selected as the sole official type name.
Overview, grouped equipment pages, categories and ambitions retain 红装 as a quality or category term.
Only complete standalone Named/Unique labels and their paired link wrappers were changed; long narrative sentences were not rewritten.
This follow-up does not modify developer-blog titles or the original English, hashes, revisions, scopes or provenance.
